description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for updating database tables and data during a software upgrade, specifically for migration version 128 of Revive Adserver. It includes methods for altering table fields, migrating banner properties, and updating access control lists (ACLs).

classes.name: Migration_128
classes.description: A class extending Migration to handle database schema and data updates for version 128 of Revive Adserver, including banner property migrations and ACL updates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the migration task list and object map for banners.

methods.name: beforeAlterField__banners__transparent
methods.description: Alters the 'transparent' field in 'banners' table for PostgreSQL syntax.

methods.name: beforeAddField__banners__parameters
methods.description: Prepares to add 'parameters' field to 'banners' table.

methods.name: beforeAddField__banners__acls_updated
methods.description: Prepares to add 'acls_updated' field to 'banners' table.

methods.name: afterAddField__banners__acls_updated
methods.description: Finalizes addition of 'acls_updated' field and triggers data migration.

methods.name: migrateData
methods.description: Coordinates migration of banner properties and ACLs, setting database output format for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: migrateSwfProperties
methods.description: Migrates SWF banner properties, updating 'transparent' field and extracting embedded object code.

methods.name: migrateGoogleAdSense
methods.description: Updates banners with Google AdSense scripts, wrapping existing code with additional scripts.

methods.name: migrateAcls
methods.description: Updates ACL entries, converting old types to new format, and handles incompatible limitations.

methods.name: _getDeliveryLimitationPlugin
methods.description: Instantiates and caches delivery limitation plugin objects based on type.
